revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261126 --uop-sse-native (opt-in, off by default, only with --uop-sse): the uop tier gains native SSE ops 120-142 that run the 06c handler arm inline on the XMM file (memory forms through 109's window guard and service op), and the host plumbs set_uop_sse_native like set_uop_sse. No EIP write, callback frame, guest stack, HWND lifetime, hook or message delivery changed; callback ownership remains pending. Re-anchored on the uop-opt review at the opt/uop-flags merge (both sides kept: uop-opt ops 111-113 and set_uop_opt, SSE-native ops 120-142 and set_uop_sse_native).
